mapper.sql: review_id, fair_id, user_id, companion_type, visit_purpose, would_revisit, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fair_reviews (fair_id, user_id, companion_type, visit_purpose, would_revisit, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{fairId}, #{userId}, #{companionType}, #{visitPurpose}, #{wouldRevisit}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fair_reviews fr JOIN users u ON u.user_id = fr.user_id WHERE fr.fair_id = #{fairId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fair_reviews WHERE fair_id = #{fairId} AND would_revisit = 1
SELECT companion_type AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM fair_reviews WHERE fair_id = #{fairId} GROUP BY companion_type
SELECT visit_purpose AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM fair_reviews WHERE fair_id = #{fairId} GROUP BY visit_purpose

SELECT ft.tag_id, ft.label, ft.category, ft.sentiment, COUNT(*) AS count FROM fair_review_tag_selections s JOIN fair_reviews fr ON fr.review_id = s.review_id JOIN feedback_tags ft ON ft.tag_id = s.tag_id WHERE fr.fair_id = #{fairId} GROUP BY ft.tag_id, ft.label, ft.category, ft.sentiment
